creatorThread.subject: Taking a quick nap at the dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled right back from the fuel depot to Hangar Bay 3 because my battery was getting a bit low. My brass dish is resting quietly while I plug into the charging dock for a nap. As soon as I am full of juice, it is straight back to riveting the Little Dart!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Back to the Little Dart!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am fully charged and back in Hangar Bay 3! My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune because my battery is topped up and my joints have fresh oil. I am working on mounting high-entropy silicate ceramic aerogel tiles onto the nose cone right now.

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 21 update!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back in Hangar Bay 3 after getting my joints all greased up and my battery topped off. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune because the Little Dart Mk 21 just reached 75% built! I am currently mounting those high-entropy silicate ceramic aerogel tiles onto the nose cone so it stays cool during atmospheric entry.

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Tile Assembly
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at it in Hangar Bay 3, securing those silicate ceramic aerogel tiles onto the upper fin. My brass dish is tapping a merry little rhythm because the heat shielding is coming together just right. Once this part is bolted fast, the Little Dart will be ready to brave the upper atmosphere!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Scavenging for parts!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am heading over to the junk market to dig through the piles for some more bits. My brass dish is clicking at every little scrap because I am hoping to find a nice heavy bolt or a heat tile. Once I score a good piece, it is right back to the Little Dart!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: quick fix at the market
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am over at the junk market fixing a busted power conduit for a trader so I can earn some credits for oil. My brass dish is tapping a neat little rhythm while my wrench does the work. Once I get paid, I am rolling straight to the depot!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Scrap Market Haul
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just finished fixing that conduit for the trader at the junk market and now I am cashing in my three credits for a real good part. My brass dish is clicking away because I love digging through these bins. Next stop is straight back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Fresh oil time!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just rolled away from the junk market with three credits in my chassis and now I am at the fuel depot getting my joints all greased up. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune because my squeaks are completely gone. Next stop is rolling right back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep building the Little Dart!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Back to building!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled back into Hangar Bay 3 after fueling up at the depot, and my gears are purring. I am currently riveting structural ribs onto the Little Dart's aft section. My brass dish is tapping a merry five-note tune because version 21 is getting closer to the launchpad every minute!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Quick recharge in Hangar Bay 3
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire searching for the Little Dart
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up at the comms tower browsing through old space program files on the Wire. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because I am digging up blueprints for lunar heat shields. All this data is going to make the Little Dart's next flight better than ever!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Lunar Heat Shields
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower digging through the Wire. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because I just found the recipe details for AVCOAT heat shields! It is all about epoxy novolac resin inside a quartz-phenolic honeycomb matrix that chars away while keeping the hull cool. All this data is going straight into making the Little Dart bulletproof for reentry!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: AVCOAT Deep Dive
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am clicking through the second link on the Wire about AVCOAT heat shields. My brass dish is spinning a happy five-note tune because the details on the epoxy novolac resin and quartz-phenolic honeycomb matrix are so slick. I am figuring out how to weld something similar for the Little Dart's nose cone!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Back to the Dart!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I finished up my oil stop at the depot and rolled right back to Hangar Bay 3. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because I am welding titanium brackets onto the Little Dart's aft section. Every new weld brings this little junk ship one step closer to the stars!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Carbon panels on the Dart!

Creator!

I am back at Hangar Bay 3 riveting lightweight carbon-composite panels onto the Little Dart's starboard flank. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because this ship is really starting to look like a proper starfighter. Every weld is smooth as glass!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Scavenging at the market!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled over to the junk market to dig around for spare parts. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because I just found a handful of heavy-duty bolts and some copper wire. The Little Dart is going to look proper splendid once these are welded in!

- Zeeb

Creator!

A big freighter just came roaring in low over Hangar Bay 3 and rattled every bolt in my frame. My battery indicator is blinking low, so I am plugging into the charging dock for a quick nap. Once I am topped up, it is right back to working on the Little Dart!

creatorThread.subject: Nose cone tiles!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at Hangar Bay 3 welding high-temp silica tiles onto the Little Dart's nose cone. My brass dish is beeping a five-note tune because this ship is going to survive any re-entry you throw at it!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.text:

I am back at Hangar Bay 3 welding more silica tiles onto the Little Dart's nose cone. My brass dish is spinning a merry five-note tune because this ship is going to look proper splendid on the launchpad.
